  "fixes": [
    "Replace the six-row opening-hours chart with one compact schedule near the shop address, bring the location into the hero, and remove the duplicate footer schedule.",
    "Use the finished-bouquet image in the hero and move the tools-and-workbench image to the supporting section so visitors see the product immediately.",
    "Reduce desktop section padding and tighten the mobile pricing-category gaps to create a shorter, more consistent reading rhythm."

    "Phone and desktop: opening hours and the holiday-opening note are repeated in the main schedule section and footer."
